items.text: ETR Sunday injuries list Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel as OUT. Schefter and Rapoport confirm 49ers ruled both out vs Falcons; Shanahan coach confirm on Evans.
items.why: Final injury report and coach confirmation
items.implication: 49ers WR corps depleted; heavy funnel to Kittle and CMC
items.opportunity: Increased TE/RB targets and snaps in pass game

items.text: Davante Adams and Rashee Rice listed OUT by ETR; Schefter includes both in official ruled-out list (Rice pictured).
items.why: Final designations; Adams multi-week hamstring expected
items.implication: Rams TE target share spike possible; KC WR hierarchy shifts
items.opportunity: Higbee/Parkinson elevated if Puka also limited; Worthy/others in KC

items.text: Puka Nacua (calf), Lamar Jackson (ankle), Breece Hall (quad) all QUESTIONABLE on ETR dump. Levitan flags statuses as crucial for DFS slate; McVay says Puka tests pregame, minor but power/explosion limited.
items.why: Final Friday reports; game-time elements for all three
items.implication: Major slate pivots; early news needed
items.opportunity: If OUT: Higbee #1 hierarchy for Stafford; Ravens/Jets backups elevated

items.text: David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Jeremiyah Love OUT per ETR and Schefter list. Levitan notes sneaky important scratches.
items.implication: Houston RB committee shifts; TB/IND/ARI depth impacted
items.opportunity: Handcuffs and remaining backs/WRs gain snaps/targets

items.text: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison (and Hockenson) listed IN by ETR. Levitan notes Jacobs facility access (meetings/lifting) and weak backups (Lloyd/Johnson EPA).
items.why: Cleared on final list after prior uncertainty
items.implication: Jacobs returns from layoff; Judkins/Addison full go
items.opportunity: Jacobs lead back but workload questions post-layoff
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs this week on workload concern

items.text: Berry LOVES Saquon (if active vs DAL, efficient prior, great matchup; back in lineups), Jaylen Warren (@NO), Chuba Hubbard (vs TB), Bucky Irving (@CAR) for workloads/matchups. Loveland BACK: 30% ts / 19.2 PPR w/ Caleb, 6+ rec both games.
items.why: Saquon return efficiency + DAL matchup; volume RBs vs soft run Ds; Loveland post-Caleb stats
items.implication: Start all if active; Loveland TE upside
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps for RBs; target share for Loveland

items.text: Seahawks ruled Zach Charbonnet OUT vs Chiefs (Schefter). ETR confirms. Opens more work for Kenneth Walker III.
If Puka Nacua can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Mumpfield 3. Parkinson 4. Atwell etc. Berry notes prior Puka-out TE share hit 37%.
items.why: McVay details on calf (no single play, felt lack of power/explosion); pregame test
items.implication: TE-heavy if Puka sits; Adams already multi-week out

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT creates sweet setup for Bijan Robinson vs 49ers. SF DvP inflates opposing RB production 4.4% (7th-most); recent RBs saw solid catches/TDs. Bijan full workload expected.
items.why: B-Rob hamstring OUT; SF allowing RB production recently (White, Holani, Harvey, Love)
items.implication: Bijan clear lead with goal-line/third-down upside unlocked
items.opportunity: Snap share, carries, targets, RZ near 100% of backfield

items.text: Kittle will go nuts: scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Tempted by CMC slot usage comments despite usual skepticism on RB-as-WR claims; Kaelon Black presence noted.
items.why: WR injuries force funnel; CMC smiled at slot question
items.implication: Kittle high-end TE1 lock; CMC receiving upside boost
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, slot snaps for both

items.text: Luther Burden elite 2.56 YPRR on only 68.8% routes; Kmet IR (season-ending knee, Johnson confirm) may cut 2/3-TE sets for more Burden juice. Henderson down to 21% snaps last 3 weeks - downgrade.
items.why: Kmet to IR; Burden efficiency + route rate data; Henderson snap collapse
items.implication: Burden breakout candidate; Henderson sit/flex only
items.opportunity: Burden route/target share expansion; Henderson limited role

items.text: Berry LOVES A.J. Brown (97% routes/33% ts buy after drops, @CHI), DeVonta Smith (elite volume vs DAL), Tucker Kraft (@DET TE buffet). Lions D gift to pass catchers; Bears good for yardage.
items.why: Usage (AJB routes/ts) + matchup (DET TE TDs allowed, CHI yardage)
items.opportunity: High route/target shares in favorable spots

items.text: Berry HATES Rome Odunze (vs NE/Gonzalez shadow, outside targets), Josh Downs (@MIN low scoring), Travis Kelce (@SEA tough pass D), Josh Jacobs (workload Q after layoff @DET).
items.why: Nasty matchups + role/target issues; Jacobs post-layoff risk
items.conflict: ETR/Levitan have Jacobs IN with some positive facility notes

items.text: 10 Facts: AJ Brown 97% routes/33% ts (buy despite drops); prior Puka-out Rams 37% TE target share (Higbee preferred short-term w/ Adams out); other usage notes on Mayer, etc.
items.why: Week 6 utilization + historical Puka absence data
items.implication: AJB buy-low; TE stream if Puka sits
